failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: All profile runs completed, but short-lived executor RSS was absent from three byte-burst evidence samples.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: Instantaneous process-tree sampling occurred after short executor children had exited.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: The worker retains executor process-tree peak RSS and the evidence runner merges retained and instantaneous samples.

failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: A transient Windows heartbeat replace lock stopped the CPU-one worker during D.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: Atomic heartbeat replacement raised a bounded WinError 5 while a reader held the file.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: Heartbeat replacement uses bounded retry and remains fail-closed after retry exhaustion.

failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: A full strict run failed S2-AC-01 and S2-AC-04 after G reached twenty CPU downstream outstanding and E lost pre-restart queue-wait evidence.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: Ambiguous rejected submissions released fenced reservations too early, and restart evidence did not merge the pre-restart queue-wait histogram.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: Ambiguous effects remain outcome_unknown until reconciled, and restart evidence merges the retained queue-wait histogram.

failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: The run stopped after F repetition three because the injected deadline was expired in the database clock but still future-dated in the worker clock.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: The fixture assumed synchronized clocks and subtracted only one second.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: The fixture chooses the earlier database or worker clock minus a fixed ten-second margin and records both clocks and the delta.

failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: The run stopped at I repetition one even though worker recovery, terminal closure, parity, and cleanup passed.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: The evidence contract incorrectly treated the intended timeout failure as a success-effect and full-success-trace obligation.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: The timeout task now requires an explicit failed/no-effect contract and a failure-path trace, while recovered and healthy tasks retain the full success contract.

claim_boundary: Controlled external HTTP, PostgreSQL, process, Prometheus, OTLP, and one-GPU evidence on one local physical node. No customer traffic, production SLA, physical-node HA, DR, or multi-GPU claim. S2 verification does not imply S3 or final S0-S8 system verification.
